summary: Mission Control stays on, comes back with any launchpad command, and always has a way to enter your key.
notes: Mission Control stays on after Claude Code closes, and every launchpad command brings it back.
Already bought launchpad? Mission Control has an Activate link in its top bar.
Mission Control's windows now come one after another instead of waiting for your next visit.
Onboarding skips steps it already finished and keeps the email you typed in the chat.
Fixes for a second app on the free build, offline messages and the header on smaller windows.

beta.summary: Every card shows one clear way to do it, and new versions arrive as a proper update window.
notes: Each to-do shows the quickest way first; other ways sit under one fold, each marked as an alternative.
A card launchpad can do itself says so, with one Do it button.
New versions open a window with the release notes and Update now, Later or Skip this version.
A newer update is never hidden behind an older notice.
Buys through a test checkout: you are not charged.
